strategies.name: Equal-weight universe
strategies.description: Benchmark: hold all universe stocks equally.

strategies.name: sma_trend
strategies.description: Trend following: hold a stock while its 50-day SMA is above its 200-day SMA.

strategies.name: sma_trend+regime
strategies.description: Same, but in cash when Nifty < 200-day SMA or India VIX > 25.

strategies.name: donchian_breakout
strategies.description: Turtle-style: buy a 55-day closing high, exit on a 20-day closing low.

strategies.name: donchian_breakout+regime
strategies.description: Same, but in cash when Nifty < 200-day SMA or India VIX > 25.

strategies.name: rsi2_pullback
strategies.description: Buy short, sharp dips (RSI(2) < 10) in stocks above their 200-day SMA; exit on a bounce above the 5-day SMA.

strategies.name: rsi2_pullback+regime
strategies.description: Same, but in cash when Nifty < 200-day SMA or India VIX > 25.

strategies.name: bollinger_reversion
strategies.description: Buy closes below the lower Bollinger band (uptrend only); exit at the middle band.

strategies.name: bollinger_reversion+regime
strategies.description: Same, but in cash when Nifty < 200-day SMA or India VIX > 25.

strategies.name: momentum_rotation
strategies.description: Monthly: hold the 10 stocks with the best 6-month return (skipping the latest month), if positive.

strategies.name: momentum_rotation+regime
strategies.description: Same, but in cash when Nifty < 200-day SMA or India VIX > 25.

strategies.name: low_volatility
strategies.description: Monthly: hold the 10 least volatile stocks of the last year (defensive factor).

strategies.name: low_volatility+regime
strategies.description: Same, but in cash when Nifty < 200-day SMA or India VIX > 25.

findings: Nifty buy-and-hold: 9.0% a year with a worst drawdown of -60%.
Volatility is 1.9x higher when Nifty is below its 200-day SMA (29% vs 15% annualised); this is why the '+regime' variants exist.
When India VIX is above 25, the following 20 days averaged +1.6% (VIX 25-35), +4.2% (VIX >35): panic has often been a buying opportunity for patient money, but with very wide swings.
After 79 days where Nifty fell more than 3%, the next 20 days averaged +2.1% and were positive 66% of the time.
Overnight gaps < -2% (34 days): the move continued intraday 38% of the time and the gap filled 12% of the time.
Overnight gaps > +2% (29 days): the move continued intraday 45% of the time and the gap filled 17% of the time.

Caution: simply holding all universe stocks equally returned 19.2% a year, more than the index. Much of that is survivorship bias (the list is today's large caps), so strategy returns above the index are inflated too. Compare strategies with each other and with the equal-weight line, not only with Nifty.

High-turnover strategies (rsi2_pullback, rsi2_pullback+regime, bollinger_reversion, bollinger_reversion+regime) lose most of their edge to costs at 0.15% per side. Short-term mean reversion needs very low costs to work on daily data.

Strategies with a better Sharpe ratio than Nifty both before and after 2019: momentum_rotation (OOS CAGR 14.3%, Sharpe 0.48, max DD -37%); low_volatility (OOS CAGR 11.5%, Sharpe 0.41, max DD -26%); sma_trend (OOS CAGR 11.2%, Sharpe 0.36, max DD -35%).
